resources.string: Enter # followed by exactly six hexadecimal digits (0–9, A–F). Alpha and shorthand are not supported.
Enter a whole percentage from 0 to 100.

Mixes the encoded red, green and blue sRGB channels, rounded to the nearest 8-bit value. This is not paint mixing, physical light mixing or linear-light interpolation. Both colors are opaque; alpha is not supported.

0 percent returns the first color; 100 percent returns the second. Editing or explicitly importing inputs clears the previous result. Press Blend to generate a new result. If Remember results is enabled, reopening can restore your last completed blend; presets and History imports still require Blend.
Choose two colors and press Blend.
This saved setup is not a valid Color Blend input. Your current inputs were kept.
